biotools.summary: TBEP is a network-based bioinformatics tool that accelerates drug target and biomarker discovery by integrating multimodal datasets and leveraging an integrated large language model (LLM) for interactive data exploration. It is available as a web application and includes a GitHub repository with documentation and source code.
